about.text: A cows' milk cheese, with Dutch and Swiss influence.

sources.text: Created by accident in 1991 at SM Spomlek (Radzyn Podlaski) after a wrong starter strain; pasteurised cow milk, 4 weeks ripening, large round eyes, produced only by Spomlek. Rind type not stated
